restaurants.name: Maharaja Restaurant
restaurants.description: Authentic North and South Indian cuisine in the heart of Bremen. Known for their crispy samosas and aromatic chaats.

restaurants.name: Karachi Corner
restaurants.description: A cozy Pakistani street food spot in the Viertel district. Their Gol Gappay and Chapli Kebabs are crowd favourites.

restaurants.name: Dhaka Delight
restaurants.description: Bremen's favourite Bangladeshi spot. Serves authentic Fuchka and Chotpoti with tangy tamarind water just like the streets of Dhaka.

restaurants.name: Spice Route
restaurants.description: A modern South Indian and street food café. Try their classic Vada Pav and Mumbai-style Bhel Puri.

restaurants.name: Punjab Palace
restaurants.description: Popular Punjab-style eatery serving hearty Punjabi snacks including freshly fried samosas and a beloved Chana Chaat.

groceries.name: Asia Supermarkt Bremen
groceries.description: Large Asian supermarket near the central station. Stocks a wide range of South Asian spices, lentils, flours, and fresh produce.

groceries.name: Bollywood Spices & Foods
groceries.description: Specialist Indian grocery store with an impressive spice section. Best in Bremen for authentic chaat masala and hard-to-find South Asian pantry staples.

groceries.name: Halal World Markt
groceries.description: Halal grocery and butcher with a strong South Asian section. Great source for fresh halal meat for Chapli Kebab and staple dry goods.

groceries.name: Lanka & Desi Kirana
groceries.description: South Asian and Sri Lankan grocer well-stocked for South Indian cooking. Excellent selection of ingredients for Dosa, Idli, and Sambar.

groceries.name: Global Foods Bremen
groceries.description: International food market with a well-organized South Asian aisle. Perfect for sourcing the full ingredient list for Bhel Puri, Chotpoti, and Chaat.
